clean_story:
Now I will teach you Sometimes.
Sometimes is like sun come, sun go—not always there, but happens again.
Like rain fall, then stop, then fall again.
Like fire burn bright, then low, then bright again.
Not all time, not never, but in between.
This is Sometimes.

Discover often, rarely, time.
